proposed_global_claims.statement: The displayed branch is smooth with coordinate ring C[z,z^-1,(z-1)^-1]; Q and Q-1 are units, and R=1/z+1/(z-1) descends to the affine branch ring.

For the finite-normalization factorization of a generically finite polynomial map, the image of the omitted source boundary equals the nonproperness set; a divisor mapping onto the displayed branch makes that branch an irreducible component.
proposed_global_claims.nonclaims: No classification of all source-boundary divisors.

proposed_global_claims.statement: Jelonek--Lason Theorem 3.2 makes the nonproperness set of a generically finite polynomial map C^n to C^m componentwise covered by nonconstant polynomially parametric curves.
proposed_global_claims.nonclaims: Bound only to the exact primary-source hypotheses.

proposed_global_claims.statement: Every morphism A1 to the displayed three-puncture branch is constant because Q and Q-1 pull back to units of C[t].
proposed_global_claims.nonclaims: No statement about rational maps from P1.

proposed_global_claims.statement: No polynomial Keller realization can have a finite-normalization source-boundary divisor mapping onto the displayed branch.
proposed_global_claims.nonclaims: No general one-boundary theorem, qualifying weight, ramification bound, or JC_2 conclusion.
